notes.title: 【UFO】 will be released on September 27th!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3134540/
[b]We are honored to announce that 【UFO】 will be released on September 27th![/b]

[h1]The game is priced at 0.99 USD, with a 10% discount during the first week.[/h1]
Additionally, players who have already purchased "Cave Fiction" on Steam will receive an extra discount. For more details, please check the bundle:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33953/

About the bundle:
"The Cave Trilogy" is the first trilogy I have planned, although I'm not yet a seasoned developer. However, throughout the process of creating this trilogy, I have slowly learned many techniques. "UFO" is the second part, and unlike "Cave Fiction," it leans more towards expression and stream-of-consciousness. So, those who resonate with it may be very happy, while those who don't might find it dull.

After the release of "UFO," I will update "Cave Fiction," primarily to optimize the translation.

In the future, aside from "Chest," you might already notice the silhouette of the third part in the bundle's promotional image. I won't say much more here, so stay tuned!

Here, I would like to express my gratitude to the friends who have helped me, whether it was in music production or translation. Independent games are already a niche area, and the denpa genre is even more niche within that. Thank you to all the friends who have supported me.


Li
24/9

notes.title: Two big events! Two big events!
notes.content:
A：As the title suggests, I am honored to announce that the Japanese BETA version and English testing version of "Cave Fiction" have been released. In this testing version, a resolution option has been added. (However, you need to clear your progress and restart the game.) I would also like to express my sincere gratitude to Mr. iugennnnn and the couple, keshan sixin, for their support in creating the Japanese and English versions. (Bows)

B：At the same time, I am very pleased to announce the release of my new game, "Chest."[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2905350/chest/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42340983/a03ee02762b4f312bfb73b56f576df3facd800ff.png[/img][/url]
In "Chest," you'll see our charming character, Sandy, return in a new form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42340983/460b9b8299a075eb7c2120a266fe3a523668dbdd.jpg[/img]
C:Furthermore, "Cave Fiction" will be having its lowest discount ever. 
[h3][b]The discount period is from April 30th to May 7th.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42340983/c35e4d0f5f31e8e21790030cf1fadb41260701dd.png[/img]

notes.title: Update and Fix on July 27, 2023
notes.content:
Here's the situation. Some friends who are still using low-resolution devices complained that they couldn't fully experience the game. So, I've added resolution settings.
Currently, there are two supported resolutions:
1600x900
800x450

Additionally, bugs have been fixed, and a guide has been added.

If any friends need a larger resolution, please input "123123123kirA" in the test version and select the Steamsh branch.

Thank you.

notes.title: Updates and Prospects for 2023-07-22
notes.content:
[h2]Updates and Prospects - Version 1.11[/h2]

In this version, we have made some fixes to incorrect statements and code errors. Additionally, we addressed potential bugs that might occur.

If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out to me.
 You can contact me through the QQ group: 243518944
 or on our [b]DISCORD channel: https://discord.gg/eXfrRDHfjK.[/b]

I will be updating and addressing any reported bugs on weekends.

[h2]Now, let's talk about the updates, which have two key points:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Japanese Version: We have found partners for the Japanese translation, and once everything is ready, we will optimize the Japanese version's translation. Other languages are also actively being prepared, so if you're willing to help, please contact me through the provided channels.

[*] Mac Version: The Mac version is on its way and will be available soon. I hope our Mac users will also get to experience the game.
[/list]

[h2]Lastly, let's talk about the future plans. [/h2]
One week after release, I want to express my gratitude for all the support. The current sales have already exceeded my expectations. With the revenue from this game, I plan to bring you accurate and high-quality multilingual versions and stories that observe the world from a unique perspective as soon as possible.

Your support motivates me to keep developing games from a niche perspective.
Thank you! 
                                          
                                                                                                                               GOOODMON's li
